THE PORTRAIT EDIT
ISSUE 02 / THE PROMPT ISSUE
RUNWAY
076
STUDY 054
Camel Double-Breasted Runway Coat
Rights check
Source: 24376.jpg
IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with long, sleek blonde hair
pulled back walks a runway. She wears a camel
double-breasted wool coat with gold buttons, a shawl
collar with a long matching scarf, and a self-tie belt at
the waist. Tall camel suede knee-high boots complete
the look. Her expression is calm and direct. A dark
wooden backdrop, a violet carpet runway, and warm
stage lighting. Palette of camel, gold, and violet.
Structured and polished, in the style of a fall runway
editorial.
Structured, polished, warm
WORKING NOTES
- The double-breasted coat and matching scarf define the
look.
- Add 'mid-stride' to capture the walk.
